item.title: The EBA publishes its final Guidelines on the management of third-party risk, delivering a more proportionate and consistent framework aligned with DORA
item.description: As part of the European Banking Authority’s (EBA) ongoing efforts to simplify its regulatory framework, the Guidelines focus on third-party arrangements supporting critical or important functions (CIFs) namely the disruption of which would materially impair the performance of a financial entity. By concentrating on these higher-risk arrangements, the Guidelines reduce unnecessary operational and supervisory burdens for less material ones while maintaining sound risk management. — Thématique réglementation ; source jugée fiable (european banking authority) ; impact réglementaire.
